title: The Future of South American Militaries and Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief Operations
summary_en: The 2026–2027 super El Niño is expected to intensify existing challenges and pose new threats across South America. CSIS Americas Program nonresident senior associate Wilder Alejandro Sánchez examines the role South American militaries can play in delivering critical humanitarian assistance and supporting disaster response efforts.

title: Middle Power Ties in the Gulf and Africa: The Iran War Inflection Point
